title: Gibbs Manifold: analysis and simulation code for 'Variability as a Frontier of Metabolic Efficiency'
description:
Code, analysis pipelines, and analytical scripts accompanying the manuscript Variability as a Frontier of Metabolic Efficiency: How Neural Dynamics Converge to Thermodynamic Optimality by Huang, Lin, Roe, and Yu.

The repository contains: (i) Python scripts that derive and plot the universal Gibbs frontier under linear and sublinear cost functions in the (CV, ICE) plane; (ii) MATLAB pipelines that apply the Direct-Method spike-train entropy estimator to the macaque V1/V2 dataset (CRCNS v1v2-1), including the noise-entropy fraction H(r|s)/H(r) check; (iii) a single-neuron leaky integrate-and-fire model with inhibitory plasticity; (iv) a recurrent spiking network with E/I plasticity that self-organises toward a high-CV regime; and (v) a CV-maximising sparse-coding learning rule (PyTorch) together with baseline comparisons and Pareto scans. The repository is organised by figure (Fig1/--Fig7/); the top-level README documents per-figure entry points, software dependencies, and dataset locations.
notes: The 'Fig2/' directory redistributes five session files from the CRCNS v1v2-1 dataset under the CRCNS data-sharing terms. All other source code is released under the MIT License.
